summary.en: U.S. futures rally ahead of CPI report with all three major indexes ticking higher; oil remains elevated near $84 supporting energy sector, while AI chip earnings uncertainty creates mixed sentiment in big tech names.
summary.zh: 美股期货盘前上涨，三大指数均走高；油价维持在$84 附近支撑能源板块，AI 芯片财报不确定性导致大科技股情绪分化。

title.en: All Three Major Index Futures Rise Ahead of CPI Release
title.zh: 三大指数期货在 CPI 发布前上涨

topNews.impact: Futures show broad risk-on positioning with Nasdaq leading (+0.71%). S&P futures up +0.26% suggests steady equity sentiment ahead of inflation data.

title.en: WTI Crude Holds Near $84 Despite Geopolitical Calm
title.zh: WTI 原油维持在$84附近，尽管地缘政治紧张局势缓解

topNews.impact: Oil prices elevated supports energy stocks and inflation hedges, but weighs on airline and consumer discretionary sectors. Supply concerns persist despite diplomatic progress.

macroRisk.en: Elevated oil prices support inflation expectations, potentially constraining Fed rate-cut timing; benefit energy ETF but pressure on industrials.
macroRisk.zh: 高油价支撑通胀预期，可能限制美联储降息时机；利好能源 ETF 但压制工业股表现。

title.en: Big Tech Earnings Noise Creates Sector Divergence
title.zh: 大科技财报噪音导致板块分化

topNews.impact: AI chip valuation debates continue with AMD earnings beat but mixed stock reaction. Cloud revenue remains strong for hyperscalers.

title.en: Gold and Precious Metals Stabilize Above Key Support Levels
title.zh: 黄金和贵金属稳定在关键支撑位上方

topNews.impact: Safe-haven demand supports precious metals despite mixed market. Gold near $4,400 offers downside protection for portfolio.

title.en: Treasury Market Watches July CPI for Rate Cut Odds Reset
title.zh: 债市关注 7 月 CPI 数据以重置降息概率

topNews.impact: 10Y yield stability critical for duration-sensitive sectors. Dovish surprise could spark rally in rate-laggard growth stocks.

title.en: European Markets Mixed as U.S. Futures Lead Pre-Open Rally
title.zh: 欧洲市场分化，美股期货引领盘前反弹

topNews.impact: DAX up 0.35% while FTSE flat, suggesting risk appetite remains elevated despite some regional weakness.

title.en: CPI Report Tonight Could Trigger Sharp Market Volatility
title.zh: 今晚的 CPI 报告可能引发剧烈市场波动

topNews.impact: July inflation data is the key Fed decision point. Mild print could spark rate cut rally, while hot readings restore hawkish bias.

macroRisk.en: Asymmetric CPI impact: weak data boosts growth stocks via rate cut hopes, while hot prints could trigger broad sell-off.
macroRisk.zh: CPI 影响不对称：弱数据通过降息预期提振成长股，而通胀过热可能引发普遍抛售。

ai.en: Mixed sentiment amid earnings uncertainty. Nvidia rally offset by AMD concerns despite beat. AI chip valuations elevated with high short-term expectations.
ai.zh: 财报不确定性下情绪分化。英伟达上涨抵消 AMD 担忧，尽管超预期表现。AI 芯片估值偏高且短期预期过高。

semiconductor.en: Divergent performance: memory chips (WAFERS/MXLC) strong on data center demand, while logic chip names face valuation pressure from high expectations.
semiconductor.zh: 表现分化：数据中心需求支撑存储芯片，而逻辑芯片股面临高期望下的估值压力。

bigTech.en: Big Tech benefit from futures rally with cloud revenue drivers. MSFT/GOOGL outperform on AI infrastructure growth, consumer names face EV rotation pressure.
bigTech.zh: 大科技受益于期货上涨和云收入驱动，微软谷歌因 AI 基础设施增长跑赢，消费股面临电动车板块轮动压制。

energy.en: Oil near $84 supports energy sector with elevated commodity prices. XLE names benefit but face headwinds from geopolitical risk premium fading.
energy.zh: $84 油价支撑能源板块，大宗商品价格高位有利。XLE 受益于高商品价格但面临地缘风险溢价消退的逆风。

ev.en: Tesla faces pressure amid tech rotation. Rivian offers relative value but sector near-term volatility expected from broader auto/manufacturing regime.
ev.zh: 特斯拉在科技股轮动中承压，Rivian 提供相对价值但板块短期波动受整体汽车/制造周期影响。

market.en: Broad market positive with futures suggesting moderate open. AI divergence creates noise but earnings season continues driving broad-based growth rotation.
market.zh: 大盘乐观，期货显示温和开盘。AI 分化带来噪音但财报季继续驱动广泛成长股轮动。

preciousMetals.en: Gold holds near $4,400 support with geopolitical hedging demand. Safe-haven flows could provide floor if CPI volatility triggers market uncertainty.
preciousMetals.zh: 金价持稳$4,400 附近支撑，地缘避险需求显著。若CPI波动引发市场不确定性，避险资金可能提供底部保护。

oil.en: $83.61 WTI with upside limited to geopolitical shocks but downside cushion available below $75 if supply fears subside.
oil.zh: WTI 油价$83.61，上行空间受地缘冲击限制但若供应担忧消退则下方有缓冲空间。

futures.en: +0.26% S&P, +0.71% Nasdaq leading rally with broad sector participation.
futures.zh: 标普指数期货上涨+0.26%，纳指涨幅领先达+0.71%，广泛行业参与

treasury10Y.en: ~3.85-4.0%, stabilizing ahead of CPI volatility release tonight.
treasury10Y.zh: 约 3.85%-4.0%，今晚CPI波动释放前趋于稳定。

dxy.en: ~97, stable with geopolitical calm supporting dollar but inflation data could alter positioning overnight.
dxy.zh: 美元指数在$97附近，地缘缓和支撑美元但通胀数据可能改变夜间配置

oil.en: $83.61 WTI up 0.49%, geopolitical tension fading but supply fundamentals intact.
oil.zh: WTI $83.61上涨 0.49%，地缘紧张缓和但供应基本面未变

keyRisk.en: CPI report tonight is asymmetric: mild print boosts growth via rate cut hopes, hot readings risk broad sell-off.
keyRisk.zh: 今晚CPI报告影响不对称：温和数据通过降息预期提振成长股，过热读数风险引发全面抛售

note.en: Futures rally supported by calm geopolitics and energy sector strength but AI earnings uncertainty and asymmetric CPI risk keep sentiment mixed.
note.zh: 期货上涨受地缘缓和和能源板块强劲支撑，但AI 财报不确定性和CPI风险不对称性使情绪保持分化。

disclaimer.en: Data compiled from public sources; market commentary reflects synthesis of available headlines and macro logic.
disclaimer.zh: 数据来源于公开渠道；市场点评基于已有头条新闻与宏观逻辑的综合研判
